source: Port of Shanghai via Container News (2026): 55.06 million TEU in 2025 (+6.9%), of which international transshipment 7.911 million TEU (14.4%) and sea-rail 1 million TEU. Port node placed at Waigaoqiao; about half of volume is handled at Yangshan.

source: San Pedro Bay ports, calendar 2025: Port of Los Angeles 10,239,318 TEU plus Port of Long Beach 9,881,595 TEU = 20,120,913 TEU. Transshipment negligible.
